name: ui_wait
description: Wait for a UI element to appear (or disappear) on screen with a configurable timeout. Polls at regular intervals. Essential for robust automation -- use after tapping a button or launching an app to wait for the next screen to load. Set absent=true to wait for disappearance.

absent.description: Wait for element to disappear instead of appear (default: false)

content_desc.description: Content-description (accessibility label) to wait for. Case-insensitive substring by default; set exact=true for full-string equality.

device_id.description: Device ID (optional if only one device connected)

exact.description: Match id/text/content_desc by full-string equality (case-insensitive) instead of the default substring match.

id.description: Resource ID of the element to wait for. Case-insensitive substring of the simple id (text after ':id/') by default; set exact=true for full-id equality.

text.description: Visible text to wait for. Case-insensitive substring by default; set exact=true for full-string equality.

arguments.description: Generated MCP request struct for this tool.
arguments.title: UiWaitRequest
